description: Implementation of DobbyContainer and DobbyContainerAdministrator classes for managing containers via Dobby proxy, including container creation, destruction, status checks, and info retrieval.

classes.name: DobbyContainer
classes.description: Represents a Dobby-managed container, providing methods to start, stop, and retrieve info about the container.

classes.name: DobbyContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages container lifecycle, including creation, destruction, and initialization of Dobby proxy and IPC service.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance based on search paths and configuration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Dobby proxy and IPC service, setting up communication with the Dobby daemon.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops IPC service, and resets proxy.

methods.name: DestroyContainer
methods.description: Stops and removes a container by name.

methods.name: ContainerNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a container with the given name is already running.

methods.name: containerStopCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops, used to fulfill stop promises.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of the container, parsing container info JSON if needed.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory info for the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor info for the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces associated with the container (not implemented).

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running based on proxy state.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters, using either a spec file or bundle.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.
